title: Contract intake: security questionnaire scoring -> pricing & liability escalation flow
creator: Alex Kim
description:
Objective: Build an operational flow that converts enterprise security questionnaire (SQ) responses into a deterministic risk score that (a) drives automated pricing and liability guardrails and (b) gates routing to Legal/Security for manual review. This ticket defines the scoring rubric, risk buckets, pricing/indemnity mapping, routing rules, and the minimal set of template amendments (DPA/appendix) to apply automatically for low/medium risk deals.

Scope:
- Define SQ->score mapping and threshold buckets (low/medium/high).
- Map risk buckets to pricing multipliers, liability caps, and indemnity language change recommendations.
- Design intake UI and API payload shape for Sales/AE to submit procurement questionnaires.
- Implement automated routing logic (Sales -> Pricing -> Legal -> Security) and SLAs per bucket.
- Provide a small set of DPA addenda phrases that can be auto-inserted for medium-risk (e.g., subprocessor list, encryption attestations) and flag high-risk for manual redline.
- Deliver dashboards for contract-exceptions and weekly reports for Revenue/Legal.

Non-goals: Full contract negotiation automation, complete legal template overhaul, or machine-signing approvals. This is a guardrail layer to reduce manual review volume and surface only high-risk deals to Legal.
acceptance_criteria: SQ scoring rubric documented in Confluence and referenced by Sales intake form
Routing rules produce deterministic outcome for provided SQ examples (low/medium/high) in test matrix
Pricing experiment configured: baseline, +5% uplift for medium risk, +15% custom quote required for high risk
Automated DPA addendum snippets applied for medium risk when enabled; high risk flagged for Legal with prefilled context
Looker dashboard shows weekly volume of auto-approved vs manual-reviewed contracts and time-to-decision metrics
comments: 2026-01-18 Alex Kim: Kickoff — collected baseline SQ examples from Sales (12 questionnaires) and sample DPAs. Agreed to start with 3 risk buckets and conservative scoring to minimize false negatives.
2026-01-25 Priya Desai: Drafted initial scoring rubric (0-100). Shared with Legal and Security for feedback. Attached mapping and two sample intake forms.

2026-02-02 Legal (review): Suggested moving clause changes into an appendix rather than the master DPA for easier toggling. Concern raised about unlimited indemnity - propose a default cap tied to annual contract value unless Sales requests escalation.

2026-02-08 Security (review): Added checks for data residency and required encryption controls. Proposed an auto-fail flag for any SQ answer that indicates missing SOC2 or equivalent for regulated customers.

2026-02-14 PM sync: Agreed pricing levers: medium risk -> nominal uplift (5%–10% depending on controls gap); high risk -> Sales must engage legal and procurement, pricing set by quote. Priya to drive A/B experiment with two sales pods.
2026-02-20 Priya Desai: Updated routing flow and created PRD draft. Next: engineering feasibility scoping with ENG-2211. Tentative due date 2026-03-15 for initial rollout to two pilot AE teams.
decision_log: Decision 2026-01-25: Use a 0-100 normalized SQ score instead of per-question thresholds to allow future ML calibration.
Decision 2026-02-02: Medium-risk outcomes will be handled via DPA appendix toggles; high-risk outcomes require Legal redline and Sales approval.
Decision 2026-02-08: Default indemnity cap = 2x ARR for medium risk; high-risk indemnity subject to Legal negotiation (documented exception process).
Decision 2026-02-14: Pricing experiment design approved: two-arm A/B across AE pods, measure deal velocity, win-rate, and time-to-contract over 8 weeks.
Decision 2026-02-20: Pilot will only auto-apply addenda when customer consents; no silent clause injections.
